family: PREREG6 section 4: {H9, H10, H13, H14, H15a} confirmatory, Holm at alpha 0.05 over the hypotheses with a sampling test (H10, H14, H15a)

H9.test: threshold comparison (no sampling test): p95 position error against the 5 m budget, per layer, E50 1x, 30 seeds

dead reckoning exceeds the budget within.statistic: p95 in the first driving hour, mean over seeds

ranging stays inside the budget near the.statistic: p95 near the base, mean over seeds

absolute fixes keep it inside away from.statistic: p95 away from the base, mean over seeds

H9.decision: supported in two clauses (dead reckoning, ranging near the base); NOT supported in the third (absolute fixes away from the base: every seed above the budget)

H10.test: primary clause: paired TOST at 1x (margin 50 % of the perfect-position delay), t distribution, 30 seeds; the clauses joined by intersection-union (p = the largest clause p)

the gap grows with the fleet (4x and 8x).note: Welch one-sided, gap m x > gap 1x, at 4x and at 8x; the clause holds only if both do (p = the larger)

H13.test: threshold comparison (no sampling test): busiest-link load with authentication, 20 rovers, against 16 kbit/s (E53, 30 position draws)
H13.decision: supported: every draw <= 16 kbit/s at 1 Hz and > 16 kbit/s at 10 Hz

H14.test: exact sign test on per-seed lost jobs (expired awards), sf_ll minus drop_retry, loss 0.25, 14-day blackout, 30 seeds; plus 'no reservation stuck under sf_ll' (a property of the rule)
H14.stuck_basis: by rule, not measured (B-118 N7): the replay sets sf_ll's stuck count to 0 by construction; see results/E54_dtn.json h14.clause_2_basis

H15a.test: network minus per-step chi-square, median detection delay on slow drifts at 1 false alarm per pair-day (E56, B-96): bootstrap over events, 1,000 resamples
H15a.p_note: one-sided bootstrap p = (resamples at or above 0 + 1) / (resamples + 1), from the saved count (results/E56_integrity.json h15_resample_counts_b118; B-118 N8)

summary.H9: supported in two clauses (dead reckoning, ranging near the base); NOT supported in the third (absolute fixes away from the base: every seed above the budget)
summary.H13: supported: every draw <= 16 kbit/s at 1 Hz and > 16 kbit/s at 10 Hz
summary.H10: not supported as a whole: the primary clause holds (TOST), the 'gap grows' and 'dead reckoning larger' clauses do not (intersection-union)
